part.text:
All 7 test cases pass, and `go vet` is clean.

Implementation in `bottle_song.go`:
- `Recite(startBottles, takeDown)` loops over `takeDown` verses, starting the count at `startBottles` and decrementing, appending a blank line between verses.
- Each verse is the four standard lines, with the count word capitalized at line start (`titleCase`) and lowercase in the "There'll be …" line.
- `bottle(n)` handles singular/plural, and `remaining(n)` handles the "one green bottle" / "no green bottles" special cases.

I kept the solution self-contained (a small `titleCase` helper) rather than relying on the `Title` helper in the test file, since that only exists when compiling tests and would break a plain `go build`. No other files were changed.
